meta.title: Leonida Platinum — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker

sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.covers: Roadmap (story 60-80h, 100% ~100h, cleanup ~10h); difficulty 4/10; ~200h; 1 missable (Ch.1 balcony meditation); 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 50/66 weapons; 70/80 challenges; 15 manual saves; 100% is ~60% true completion.

sources.name: KeenGamer
sources.covers: Roadmap (~200h, 4/10); balcony meditation after Down to Earth; 39 gang ops, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday jobs, 8 vaults; 100 optional tasks; 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK, 33 underwater, 100 flamingos; 42 shooting-range golds.

sources.name: Push Square
sources.covers: 300 hours or more; 18 card sets (15 for 100%); 397 stunts in the game; 100% checklist under Progress after the story (Touch Pad > Progress).

sources.name: GTABase
sources.covers: Full list of all 55 with grades and hidden flags (28 hidden); roadmap (~200h); 5 chapters; no mission replay; cheats disable trophies and saving; 70/80 challenges.

sources.name: Exophase
sources.covers: Trophy list host; used for list verification (name, description, grade). Cited by name only — no direct URL was captured on 21 Nov 2026, none is guessed.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.covers: Trophy tracker; used for list verification. Cited by name only — no direct URL was captured on 21 Nov 2026, none is guessed.

sources.name: OutputLag
sources.covers: Full list; 28 hidden, 27 visible; ~200h; balcony meditation in Chapter 1; 15 manual save slots; Yago timed race in Chapter 3 (Race Against Yago, hourglass icon).

sources.name: Insider Gaming
sources.covers: Full list of all 55; 28 hidden trophies, many tied to the story; spoiler split between visible and hidden sections.

sources.name: GTA Scoop
sources.covers: Full list; Personal Best = max strength of both characters; Let's Go Bowling = steal 3 valuables; five trophies still being confirmed; meditation guide lists all 18 spots.

sources.name: GameMapa
sources.covers: Full list of all 55 + Gamerscore; 3-step roadmap; missable note (Chapter 1 balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot); five hidden trophies still unsolved (44, 45, 49, 50, 51); per-trophy tips.

sources.name: eGamers
sources.covers: Full list; hidden split 27 visible / 28 hidden; anything not confirmed in two sources is marked unconfirmed; trophy-vs-checklist table (stunts 250 vs 300, races 20 vs 30, challenges 50 vs 70, cards 3 vs 15, meditation 18 vs 15, vaults 5 vs 8); hard-trophy tips.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub
sources.covers: Full list; grade-count dispute (PowerPyx + Insider Gaming 6 Silver / 46 Bronze vs Push Square 5 Silver / 47 Bronze); time 200h vs Push Square 250+h; 100% checklist 35 tasks (Insider Gaming); Ten Pin PowerPyx reading; Personal Best disagreement.

sources.name: CryptoGames
sources.covers: Full list of all 55; hard-trophy tips (GTABase + PowerPyx, 18 Nov); trophy-vs-checklist table (Press-Start list, 18 Nov); A Long Road thresholds roughly 60% of true completion; time split 60-80h story / ~100h checklist / ~10h cleanup; 27 visible / 28 hidden; individual Gamerscore values differ between lists, so none are printed.

sources.name: Mobalytics
sources.covers: Full list of all 55 (walkthrough WIP); confirms In The Beginning... (cocktail, Ocean Beach) and Capital Offense (smash out of a vehicle showroom); 1 possible missable (Positive Mental Attitude); cheats disable trophies; free roam after the story for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: GamesFuze
sources.covers: Full list of all 55 WITH per-trophy Xbox Gamerscore values; hardest trophies: A Long Road AND The Shootist; 7-step platinum roadmap (story, strands, activities, crime with partner, collectibles, 100%, cheats last); cross-checked against PC Gamer, TechWiser, Beebom, Alcast HQ.

disputes.b: Push Square: up to 300h or more.
disputes.verdict: Plan on 200h; treat 300 as the cautious upper bound for a slow, thorough run. The gap is pace, not content — every source agrees the 100% checklist is the long pole.

disputes.topic: Missable: 1 vs a watch on Strangers & Freaks
disputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA Scoop flag exactly 1 possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude.
disputes.b: Stranger mission chains have windows linked to story progress, so id 25 is watched. TechWiser's 5-chain window warning (via [13]) is the reason the watch exists.
disputes.verdict: 1 missable (id 28). Id 25 is a WATCH, not a second missable: nothing in the cited sources calls a strand permanently missable, so no second missable is claimed.

disputes.topic: Personal Best: what counts as mass appeal
disputes.a: GTA Scoop + PowerPyx (via [12]): maxing the strength of both characters.
disputes.verdict: SAFE PLAY (resolved): train strength on both Lucia and Jason, ideally at the gym together — [10] reports progress doubles when both train. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — the trophy keeps its unconfirmed flag.

disputes.topic: Let's Go Bowling: what is follow-through
disputes.a: GTA Scoop + PowerPyx (via [12]): steal 3 valuables at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley; no guide says you bowl a game.
disputes.b: The big guides give no method beyond the official description.
disputes.verdict: SAFE PLAY (resolved): at the alley, take 3 valuables and leave cleanly. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — the trophy keeps its unconfirmed flag.

disputes.topic: Ten Pin: one reading, still unconfirmed
disputes.a: Official description: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
disputes.b: PowerPyx (via [12]) reads it as knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds; GameMapa [10] still lists Ten Pin among the five hidden trophies unsolved.
disputes.verdict: SAFE PLAY: try it on a bike with a melee drive-by — but the method is one source's reading and [10] still lists it unsolved, so the trophy keeps its unconfirmed flag. No spot is claimed.

disputes.a: Pest Control asks for one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs).
disputes.b: KeenGamer lists 39 gang operations in the 100% requirements.
disputes.verdict: Both are true. The trophy needs 1 per gang; 100% completion needs all 39. Do 1 per gang early for the trophy, then finish the remaining 30 for the checklist.

disputes.a: GTA Scoop's meditation guide lists all 18 spots; the trophy text says every spot.
disputes.b: Some lists count fewer spots toward 100% completion; [12] confirms the checklist counts 15 meditation spots against the trophy's 18.
disputes.verdict: Do all 18, starting with the Chapter 1 balcony spot. The trophy says every spot, so 18 is the number to chase; the smaller count is a checklist detail, not the trophy.

disputes.a: One Last Thing asks for 50 challenges.
disputes.b: PowerPyx and GTABase put 70 of the 80 challenges in the 100% requirements.
disputes.verdict: Both are true. The trophy pops at 50; keep going to 70 for the checklist, skipping the 10 hardest (PowerPyx).

disputes.a: PowerPyx + Insider Gaming: 6 Silver / 46 Bronze (PSN total 1,350).
disputes.b: Push Square: 5 Silver / 47 Bronze (which implies a 1,335 total).
disputes.verdict: Follow the majority — 6 Silver / 46 Bronze, total 1,350. Push Square's count is off by one somewhere; the guide does NOT guess which trophy it is.

disputes.a: GamesFuze [15] names the hardest trophies as A Long Road AND The Shootist.
disputes.b: PowerPyx + GTABase (via [13]) call A Long Road the hardest, period.
disputes.verdict: Follow the majority — A Long Road is the hardest; The Shootist (42 shooting-range gold medals) is the hardest SKILL trophy.

disputes.a: Beebom + CULTR (via [13]) word the final mission as Chapter 5.
disputes.b: Most guides give no chapter number for the final mission.
disputes.verdict: The guide does NOT assign a chapter to the final mission — it follows Chapter 4.

disputes.a: GamesFuze [15] prints per-trophy Gamerscore (A Long Road 100G, final mission 50G, and the rest).
disputes.b: CryptoGames [13] notes individual values differ between lists and does not print them.
disputes.verdict: The guide prints GamesFuze's values labeled per GamesFuze and does NOT treat them as canonical; the 1,000G total is the one all lists agree on.

disputes.topic: Stranger chains: five hidden trophies have windows?
disputes.a: TechWiser (via [13]) warns the Stranger mission chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.
disputes.b: No other guide gives that warning.
disputes.verdict: SAFE PLAY (single source): start each stranger chain as soon as it unlocks; do not leave strands for post-story.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.audit: Name, description and grade agree across the list sources. Roadmap and time agree [1][2][4]. Disputes D1 (time), D9 (silver count), D12 (Gamerscore values differ). The Xbox equivalent is the Mythic achievement [13].
trophies.save: No save needed — pops when the other 54 are done.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically the moment the last one lands.
Its only real requirement is A Long Road (100%), the longest job at roughly 100 hours of checklist work.
Run one playthrough on a single save plan.
Keep 10 chapter start/end saves, 1 untouched pre-final save and 4 rotating cleanup saves.
Never use cheats on this save — cheats disable trophies and saving.
The Xbox equivalent is the Mythic achievement, earned by unlocking every other achievement.
Every trophy is offline and single-player — there is no online trophy on the list.
The list splits 27 visible and 28 hidden trophies across the full-list guides.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.audit: Story trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. Listed as the first mission [1][2]. Hidden-flag count follows the 25-marked list.
trophies.save: Story save, no special slot.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; it pops when the mission ends.
It is the first main mission — nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
Story trophies cannot be missed, so finish the mission and move on.
Use this first mission to learn the controls.
No gold medal is required in any story mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.audit: Story trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. Hidden follows the 25-marked list.
trophies.save: Make the Chapter 1 end save — and keep a Chapter 1 start save until Positive Mental Attitude pops.

steps.t: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1; it pops at the chapter's end.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see id 28) — the only thing in the chapter that can be missed.
Take optional missions as they appear.
Several optional missions are only offered for a while, so do not leave them for later.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter.
There is no mission replay, so those saves are your only way back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.audit: Story trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. Hidden follows the 25-marked list.
trophies.save: Chapter 2 start + end saves.

steps.t: Finish every main mission in Chapter 2; it pops at the chapter's end.
Both Lucia and Jason are playable from here, so most of the list opens up in this chapter.
Scan unfamiliar vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel.
Study animals with binoculars as you travel — that progress counts toward 100% later.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.audit: Story trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. Hidden follows the 25-marked list.
trophies.save: Chapter 3 start + end saves.

steps.t: Finish every main mission in Chapter 3; it pops at the chapter's end.
Watch for Yago's timed race the moment it appears — it carries an hourglass icon.
Yago's strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so take the race when it shows.
Keep doing optional missions as they appear; many are only offered for a while.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.audit: Story trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. Hidden follows the 25-marked list.
trophies.save: Chapter 4 start + end saves.

steps.t: Finish every main mission in Chapter 4; it pops at the chapter's end.
By now the 100% checklist is building in the background.
Vehicle scans, animal studies and optional tasks already count toward it.
Finish any open character strands before the finale.
Their final missions are tracked separately in stage S2.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.audit: Story gold, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. Listed as the final mission [1][2]. Hidden follows the 25-marked list. Dispute D11: Beebom and CULTR word the final mission as Chapter 5 — this guide assigns no chapter to it.
trophies.save: Keep 1 untouched save from just before the final mission — the 15-slot plan reserves it.

steps.t: Play the final mission after Chapter 4; the gold pops when it ends.
Before starting it, save in a slot you do not touch again.
There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so that save is your only way back.
After the credits the game returns you to free roam.
The 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Nothing on the checklist is missable, so the real work starts now, not before.
Seven missions and all four chapter endings award trophies, so the story itself banks most of the story set.
This guide does not assign a chapter to the final mission — it follows Chapter 4, whatever some lists call it.
Check Touch Pad > Progress at any time to see what is already banked from the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.audit: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. GTABase [4] lists it in the story set.
trophies.save: Story save, no special slot.

steps.t: Play the mission Breakfast Run to the end; it pops when it does.
It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — just play the story in order.
No gold medal is needed.
Story missions have no medal requirements at all.
If you are tracking the story set, this is one of the 17 story trophies.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.audit: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. GTABase [4] lists it in the story set.
trophies.save: Story save, no special slot.

steps.t: Play the mission The Cartel Heist to the end; it pops when it does.
It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — just play the story in order.
Heist missions introduce robbery mechanics you will reuse for the crime trophies in stage S5.
No gold medal or special objective is needed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.audit: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. GTABase [4] lists it in the story set.
trophies.save: Story save, no special slot.

steps.t: Play the mission Child's Play to the end; it pops when it does.
It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — just play the story in order.
Use story missions to practise driving and shooting.
The skill trophies in stage S3 build on the same mechanics.
No gold medal or special objective is needed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.audit: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. GTABase [4] lists it in the story set.
trophies.save: Story save, no special slot.

steps.t: Play the mission Headliners to the end; it pops when it does.
It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — just play the story in order.
If a mission feels hard, remember there are no difficulty settings to lean on.
There is no medal to chase either — just finish the mission.
No special objective is needed beyond finishing the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.audit: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. GTABase [4] lists it in the story set.
trophies.save: Story save, no special slot.

steps.t: Play the mission VCIA Takedown to the end; it pops when it does.
It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — just play the story in order.
VCIA is the airport.
The free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can (id 37) happens in the same place, later.
No gold medal or special objective is needed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.audit: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. GTABase [4] lists it in the story set.
trophies.save: Story save, no special slot.

steps.t: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to the end; it pops when it does.
It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — just play the story in order.
This is the last of the named story-mission trophies; after it, the remaining story trophies are the chapter and finale ones.
No gold medal or special objective is needed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.audit: Hardest trophy on the list ([1][2][4]); name, description and grade agree [5][6]. Hidden follows the 25-marked list. Disputes D1 (time), D9 (silver count), D10 (hardest — GamesFuze also names The Shootist), D12 (Gamerscore values differ).
trophies.save: Rotate 4 cleanup saves in free roam; keep the untouched pre-final save.

steps.t: Finish the story first — the 100% Completion Checklist only unlocks after the credits, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist in the open world: every robbery, bank vault and gang operation.
Underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and card sets are on the same checklist.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — you may skip the 10 hardest.
Remember the checklist is closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, not everything.
Only 50 of 66 weapons count either — the thresholds are lenient by design.
PowerPyx puts the 100% thresholds at roughly 60% of true completion.
Time splits about 60-80 hours of story, about 100 hours of checklist and about 10 hours of cleanup.
Most of the checklist comes from doing other trophies, so it fills itself as you play.
The 100% checklist has 35 tasks (Insider Gaming via [12]) — including Smash 'n' grabs 34, Stick-ups 50, Fence narcotics $100,000, Fence jewelry $100,000 and Fence vehicles $200,000.
Save before each big mission — story missions cannot be replayed, IGN reports.
Check Touch Pad > Progress at any time; progress made during the story already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.audit: Count trophy. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. 397 stunts exist in total ([3]); the trophy needs 250.
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam activity.

steps.t: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida.
Stunt jumps and the other stunt actions are listed in the in-game progress menu.
There are 397 stunts in the game, so you need a little over half of them.
Do stunts as you travel during the story.
The counter is already running before the checklist unlocks.
Check Touch Pad > Progress to see how many stunt types you have done and which ones are left.
Clean up the rest in free roam after the story — stunts stay available.
Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida count toward the trophy.
Flying under bridges is reported as the quickest stunt kind.
The checklist counts 300 stunts against the trophy's 250; both numbers are published, the trophy pops at 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.official: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 9 activity types. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. The 9-type list is GameMapa's [10]: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video game, race, stunt.
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam activity.

steps.t: Try each of the 9 activity types once.
One go at each is enough — no win or medal is needed.
The types are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video game, race and stunt.
Work through them during the story as each activity is introduced, so none is left for the end.
Check the progress menu if one type is unclear — it names the activities the game counts.
Golf, pool and basketball are the easy ones to miss — they are on the game's own activity list.
The trophy pops the moment the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.official: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 42 Shooting Range challenges, gold in each. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. The 42 count is KeenGamer [2]. Dispute D10: GamesFuze names it the second-hardest trophy after A Long Road.
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam activity.

steps.t: Visit the shooting ranges.
Take each of the 42 challenges.
Earn a gold medal in every one — silver or bronze does not count.
Replay any challenge you miss gold on.
Ranges stay open in free roam after the story.
Gold medals here are not hard by PowerPyx's account.
They also feed the 100% checklist.
Check Touch Pad > Progress to see which ranges still lack gold.
GamesFuze names this the second-hardest trophy after A Long Road.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.official: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 14 drone race locations. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. The 14 count is the list data used by this guide.
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam activity.

steps.t: Find the Top Fun drone races and win one at each of the 14 locations.
A win at a location counts once — you do not need to win the same location twice.
Do them as you explore.
Drone races also feed the 100% checklist.
42 races run across the 14 locations — about 3 per location.
Check the progress menu for the locations you have not won yet.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 20 different races. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam activity.

steps.t: Win 20 different races — the same race won twice counts once.
Races include street races and the racing activities the game lists.
Spread them across Leonida.
Race wins also feed the 100% checklist, so they are never wasted effort.
The checklist counts 30 unique race wins against the trophy's 20; both numbers are published, the trophy pops at 20.
Check the progress menu for how many different races you have won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.official: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.audit: Single-event trophy. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. KeenGamer [2] lists fishing among the introduced activities.
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam activity.

steps.t: Take a fishing challenge against Cal.
Beat him at it.
Fishing is introduced as one of the story activities.
Look for Cal at the fishing spots.
If you lose, retry the challenge — it stays available.
Fishing also counts toward the activity types for Master of None (id 16).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.audit: Single-event trophy. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam activity.

steps.t: Find an arcade machine.
Complete one arcade game to the end.
Finishing is enough — no high score is needed.
Any of the 4 video games counts — beat one to the end.
Arcade also counts toward the activity types for Master of None (id 16).

Take Andy's missions as they appear.
Several are only offered for a while, so do not leave them for later.
The trophy pops when the final mission ends — it is one of the 17 story trophies.
Everything outside the story stays available after the credits, including side-story finales.
Andy's strand is 5 quests, Lucia-only, in Chapter 3.

trophies.save: Do Kenton's missions as they appear.

steps.t: Play Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission.
Take Kenton's missions as they appear.

trophies.save: Do Billy's missions as they appear.

steps.t: Play Billy's mission strand through to its final mission.

trophies.official: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.audit: WATCH (dispute D2): stranger chains have windows linked to story progress, so this is watched, not claimed missable. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. Dispute D13: TechWiser warns the chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.save: Do stranger strands as they appear; keep chapter saves as backup.

steps.t: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
Stranger missions are not part of 100%, but this trophy needs 8 full strands.
Take each strand as it appears — stranger chains have windows linked to story progress.
Watch Yago's timed race in Chapter 3 (Race Against Yago, hourglass icon): its strand counts here.
Finish the strands in step 3 of the roadmap, after the story, if any are still open.
TechWiser warns the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress, so start each chain as soon as it unlocks.
Eight strands earn the Silver, and Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own final-mission trophy.

steps.t: Play Randy's mission strand through to its final mission.
Take Randy's missions as they appear.
Several are only offered for a while, so do not leave them for later.
The trophy pops when the final mission ends — it is one of the 17 story trophies.
Everything outside the story stays available after the credits, including side-story finales.
Randy's strand is a 16-car Wish List in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.audit: Character-strand finale. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. KeenGamer [2] lists Tyrone's final mission among the step-3 cleanups. Dispute D13: the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.save: Do Tyrone's missions as they appear.

steps.t: Play Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission.
Take Tyrone's missions as they appear.
Several are only offered for a while, so do not leave them for later.
The trophy pops when the final mission ends — it is one of the 17 story trophies.
Everything outside the story stays available after the credits, including side-story finales.
Tyrone's strand runs through his labs, and the last quest is Jason-only in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.official: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.audit: THE missable trophy (disputes D2, D7). Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. Every guide flags this one. Whether the trophy strictly needs the Chapter 1 balcony spot is unconfirmed — the safe play is to do it anyway ([1][2][7]).
trophies.save: Keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops. That save is your only way back — there is no mission replay.

steps.t: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total, per GTA Scoop's meditation guide.
FIRST: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept.
Do that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1 — it is gone once the chapter ends, and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it.
The balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 in the Progress menu, so you can see it counted.
GameMapa notes the balcony meditation counts even though it is not marked as a spot.
PowerPyx's author earned the trophy after doing the Chapter 1 balcony meditation — doing it is the safe choice even though its necessity is unconfirmed.
Meditate at the remaining spots in free roam after the story.
Keep your Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.official: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.audit: UNCONFIRMED: which animal counts is still being confirmed — [10] and [11] both say so. SAFE PLAY: take Bret's strand and hunt the animal the strand itself names; no pre-planning by animal is possible. Dispute D13: the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.save: Do Bret's strand as it appears.

steps.t: Take Bret's hunting strand.
Hunt the unique animal he asks for.
Study animals through binoculars on the way.
100 studied animals count toward 100%.
Bret's strand also ties into the collectible card sets (Target Decks) for the 100% checklist.
Which animal counts is still being confirmed — two guides say so; hunt the animal the strand itself names.
The trophy pops when the hunt is done.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 3 full sets. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. 18 sets exist, 15 count toward 100% ([3][2]).
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam collectibles.

steps.t: Find collectible cards across Leonida and complete 3 full sets.
There are 18 card sets in the game.
You need 15 full sets for 100% completion, so 3 sets is only the start.
Cards are found in the open world — search each area thoroughly.
Check the progress menu for the sets you are missing.
Bret's Target Decks tie into this system.
Finish his strand (id 29) alongside the hunt.
The trophy needs 3 sets, the checklist 15 — both numbers are published.
Keep collecting after the trophy pops — the remaining sets are still needed for A Long Road.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 100 WAiNK locations. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. KeenGamer [2] lists 100 WAiNK locations in the 100% work.
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam collectible.

steps.t: Use the WAiNK app to WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida.
WAiNK unfamiliar vehicles and locations as you travel during the story.
That progress counts toward 100% later.
The same app scans vehicles: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles count toward 100%.
Mop up the remaining locations in free roam after the story.
Check Touch Pad > Progress to see how many locations are left.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 50 challenges (dispute D8 — the checklist needs 70 of 80). Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam activity.

steps.t: Complete 50 challenges — the game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten.
The trophy pops at 50, but keep going: the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80.
Both numbers are published — the trophy pops at 50 and the checklist needs 70.
Skip the 10 hardest challenges; the checklist lets you do exactly that.
Check the progress menu for which challenge groups are still open.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.official: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.audit: WATCH: needs your partner present and a 4-star wanted level, then a clean escape. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — but do it with your partner beside you, or it does not count.

steps.t: Play with your partner (Lucia or Jason) beside you — the trophy needs both of you.
Raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape the heat.
Several trophies need Jason and Lucia together, so most of the list opens up once both are playable in Chapter 2.
Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
Then keep moving once the heat is off.
A reported spot is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia — lose the 4-star heat there with your partner.
Bank vault robberies often trigger the wanted level — a way to reach 4 stars with your partner.
If the wanted level drops without the escape counting, raise it again and retry — free roam lets you repeat it.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.official: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.audit: WATCH: 3 shops in a row, partner present, wanted level kept throughout. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — but plan the route before the first robbery.

steps.t: Play with your partner beside you — the trophy needs both of you.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level between them.
Pick 3 shops close together.
Plan the route first, so there is no dead time between robberies.
A reported route is 3 jewelry stores north of Vice City — the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third.
If it does not pop after the third shop, rob a fourth — one guide reports the fourth as the fix.
If the wanted level is lost, the chain breaks — start the 3-shop run again.
Robberies also feed the 100% checklist, so the practice is never wasted.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 100 vehicles discovered. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 scanned ([1]).
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam collectible.

steps.t: Discover 100 vehicles across Leonida — drive, find and scan new ones as you go.
Scan with the WAiNK app: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles count toward 100%.
Keep scanning past 100, since the checklist needs 200.
New vehicles appear as you explore new areas.
The explore trophy (id 42) goes hand in hand with this one.
Scan 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them.
Scan traffic near busy roads — the efficient spot.
Check Touch Pad > Progress to see how many vehicles you have discovered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.official: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.audit: Single-use trophy: 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — combat in free roam or missions.

steps.t: Trigger Combat Focus when at least 5 enemies are in front of you.
Take down all 5 before the single Combat Focus ends.
The count resets with each new use.
Pick a busy fight (a robbery escape or a wanted-level chase) so the targets are already there.
Fill your Focus meter first, then trigger Combat Focus.
Use an assault rifle and aim at gang members — that is the reported setup.
Cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count — only gang members.
If you only get 4, retry in the next fight.
Free roam lets you repeat it as often as you like.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.official: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.audit: WATCH: the departure must be unscheduled — a normal flight does not count. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — VCIA stays open in free roam.

steps.t: Go to VCIA, the airport.
Leave by an unscheduled departure — not a normal scheduled flight.
Take a plane without going through the normal departure routine.
VCIA is the same airport from the story mission VCIA Takedown (id 12), so you already know the layout.
A reported spot is an airliner at terminals E3/E4 at VCIA.
Steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km — the trophy pops about 1 km out.
If a normal departure does not pop it, that is the point — try the unscheduled way instead.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.audit: Vague description; two new sources report the same method. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam crime.

steps.t: Rhinos are the tanks — deal with them when they show up at high wanted levels.
Raise a high wanted level in free roam until Rhino tanks are sent after you.
The reported method is to steal a tank at the Mile Zero Air Station.
Take out enemies from inside the stolen tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.official: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.audit: WATCH: undetected is the whole requirement. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — but go in quiet or not at all.

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and rob it without being detected at any point.
Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm.
No wanted level during the robbery either.
The Snap Gun comes from Chapter 3 — have it before you go in.
Go in the back door with the Snap Gun and work the safe code.
If you are spotted, the attempt fails.
Leave and try another store.
Plan the exit before you go in, so the escape is as quiet as the entry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 5 bank vaults, escape each time. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. KeenGamer [2] lists 8 vault robberies in the 100% work.
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam crime.

steps.t: Rob 5 bank vaults.
Escape after each one.
The checklist lists 8 vault robberies.
Keep going past 5 for A Long Road.
Plan each escape before you go in — the escape is part of the trophy.
One guide reports this needs the optional Chapter 4 mission "That's Where The Money Is…" — take it when it appears, then escape on a fast bike at 4 stars.
Follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open.
Vault robberies are among the required robberies for the 100% checklist.
Check the progress menu for how many vaults you have cleared.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.official: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.audit: WATCH: the escape is part of the trophy. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam crime.

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it.
Escape after the robbery — the trophy needs the escape, not just the robbery.
Plan the escape route before you hit the truck.
Armored truck robberies also feed the required robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 52 areas of Leonida. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. The 52 count is the list data used by this guide.
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam exploration.

steps.t: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every named region on the map.
Drive the full map in free roam after the story.
The story itself only takes you through part of it.
Visit the far regions — the Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga — not just Vice City.
Exploring also finds vehicles, animals, cards and WAiNK locations for the other collectible trophies.
Clear the fog first and fly — flying is the quickest way to cover all 52 areas.
Check the progress menu for the areas you have not visited yet.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.official: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 1 operation per gang, 9 gangs (dispute D6 — the checklist needs all 39). Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — free-roam crime.

steps.t: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
One per gang is enough for the trophy.
The other 30 operations are for the 100% checklist, which needs all 39.
Do 1 per gang early for the trophy.
Then finish the remaining 30 for A Long Road.
Illegal operations are among the required robberies for the 100% checklist.
Check the progress menu for which gangs you have hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.official: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.audit: Single-event trophy; the location is in the description (Ocean Beach). Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. [10] still lists it among the five hidden trophies being confirmed, so the exact trigger spot is not pinned down — the description is the play.
trophies.save: No save needed — Ocean Beach stays open.

steps.t: Go to Ocean Beach and enjoy a cocktail with a view.
Do it when you are in Vice City during the story — the beach is right there.
It is a quiet moment trophy: sit, drink, let the view count.
One guide still lists this among the five hidden trophies being confirmed, so the exact trigger spot is not pinned down — the description is the play.
Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — that is the reported play.
If it does not pop, move along the beachfront until the view spot registers.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.official: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.audit: WATCH: the smash-out must be in classic style — drive out through the showroom front. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. [10] still lists it among the five hidden trophies being confirmed, so the exact trigger spot is not pinned down.
trophies.save: No save needed — showrooms stay open in free roam.

steps.t: Go into a vehicle showroom and get in a car.
Smash your way out through the front.
Drive out through the glass and the showroom front — walking out does not count.
Pick a fast car in the showroom so the smash-out has the speed it needs.
One guide still lists this among the five hidden trophies being confirmed — drive out through the showroom front in classic style; the exact trigger is not pinned down.
Crash a car out through a showroom window — that is the reported play.
If it does not pop, try another showroom — the move is the same everywhere.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.official: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.audit: UNCONFIRMED method (dispute D4): GTA Scoop says steal 3 valuables at the alley; the big guides publish no method. PowerPyx reads it the same way (via [12]). Steps follow the safe play and keep the flag.
trophies.save: No save needed — the alley stays open.

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
SAFE PLAY: steal 3 valuables at the alley and leave cleanly — that is what GTA Scoop reports.
PowerPyx reads it the same way — steal 3 valuables at the alley; no guide says you bowl a game.
The exact trigger is still unconfirmed: no big guide publishes a method for this trophy.
Bowling also counts toward the activity types for Master of None (id 16).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.audit: UNCONFIRMED method (dispute D3): GTA Scoop says max strength of both characters; the big guides publish no method. Push Square reads it as max body fat (via [12]). Steps follow the safe play and keep the flag.
trophies.save: No save needed — train both characters through normal play.

steps.t: SAFE PLAY: train strength on both Lucia and Jason through normal play and gym-style activities.
GTA Scoop reports this trophy is about maxing the strength of both characters.
Train at the gym together — progress doubles when both characters train.
Push Square reads it differently — max body fat (Overweight) — against GTA Scoop and PowerPyx, who read max strength on both characters; the guide follows the majority and keeps the unconfirmed flag.
The exact trigger is still unconfirmed: no big guide publishes a method for this trophy.
Keep training both characters as you play.
The trophy is tied to the partnership, not to one character.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.audit: Story-linked choice trophy. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. No count is claimed for it. One source reports 500 actions changing the Criminal Profile — single source, no second confirmation.
trophies.save: No save needed — choices accumulate through the story.

steps.t: Make choices as the story offers them — the trophy tracks choices made across the game.
Play both characters' storylines.
Choices come up for Lucia and Jason alike.
No exact count is published by any cited source, so no number is farmed here — just keep choosing.
One source reports 500 actions changing the Criminal Profile — single source, no second confirmation, so the guide does not farm a number here.
PowerPyx and GTABase both say the Irredeemable profile is permanent — read the Criminal Profile guide before going on a rampage.
The trophy pops once the game's choice count is reached in normal play.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.audit: UNCONFIRMED trigger: the description says second time's the charm, but no cited source says which second attempt counts. Steps give the safe play and keep the flag.
trophies.save: SAFE PLAY: retry, do not reload an old save — a fresh second attempt is what the description points at.

steps.t: SAFE PLAY: when you fail something, retry it right away instead of reloading an old save.
The description says second time's the charm — a second attempt after a failure is the trigger to chase.
The exact trigger is still unconfirmed: no cited source says which second attempt counts.
Keep playing normally.
Retries happen on their own across a 200-hour run.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.audit: UNCONFIRMED trigger: a strange event in free roam. GTA Scoop lists it among the five still being confirmed. GTABase points to a strange event somewhere in Leonida [13]. Steps give the safe play and keep the flag.
trophies.save: No save needed — explore and let the event find you.

steps.t: SAFE PLAY: explore Leonida in free roam.
Pay attention to strange encounters.
The trophy fires when you witness something strange — it is an event, not a checklist item.
No fixed location is published by any cited source, so do not chase a pinned spot.
GTABase points to a strange event somewhere in Leonida — unconfirmed, no spot claimed.
Keep exploring after the story.
The event comes during normal free-roam play.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.official: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.audit: STILL UNCONFIRMED — NOT INVENTED (dispute D5). KeenGamer and GTA Scoop both note the precise method is still being confirmed. PowerPyx reads it as knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds (via [12]). Steps say only what the description says.
trophies.save: No save needed — try it in normal play.

steps.t: The description says: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
Try it in normal play: drive past someone on foot.
Swing a melee weapon from the vehicle as you pass.
PowerPyx reads it as knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds.
SAFE PLAY: try it on a bike with a melee drive-by — but the method is one source's reading and [10] still lists Ten Pin unsolved, so the trophy keeps its unconfirmed flag.
No spot, no vehicle and no count is claimed here — no cited source publishes a precise method yet.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.official: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.audit: Count trophy: $250,000 laundered. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — money work in free roam.

steps.t: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts.
Marked Bills come from robberies.
Bank jobs, vaults and gang operations all feed them.
Launder steadily as you play.
The total builds up across the whole run.
One fence pays the most, and the total builds up during the 100% robberies.
Check the progress menu for how much you have laundered so far.
Keep robbing after the trophy pops — the money also funds the $100,000 of shop spending for id 53.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.audit: Count trophy: $100,000 spent in shops. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — spend as you play.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 across all shops.
Weapons, clothes, food, anything the shops sell — it all counts.
Spend steadily through the run instead of saving it all for the end.
Weapons and gear bought for the other trophies count toward the total.
Check the progress menu for how much you have spent so far.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 8 garage properties. Name, description and grade agree [5][6]. The 8 count is the list data used by this guide.
trophies.save: No save needed — buy them in free roam.

steps.t: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida.
Garages store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good (id 35).
They also register for On the Spot (id 55).
Earn the money from robberies and laundering (id 52) — property is the payoff, not the grind.
Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app — about $160,000 in total.
The 4 story garages do not count toward the 8.
Check the progress menu for the garages you have not bought yet.
Buy the last garage and the trophy pops — the garages stay yours for the rest of the run.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.official: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.audit: Count trophy: 10 vehicles registered. Name, description and grade agree [5][6].
trophies.save: No save needed — register in free roam.

steps.t: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
Use the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good (id 35) — discovery and registration go together.
Store them in the garages you buy for Little Boxes (id 54) so they are not lost.
Check the app for how many vehicles are registered so far.
Register the tenth vehicle and the trophy pops.
